about_the_game:
A brutal top-down shooter set in a sector ruled by mega-corporations and torn apart by rebellion. You are Adam Crimson, a battle-hardened mercenary caught in a three-way war between corporate giants, criminal warlords, and desperate freedom fighters.

Upgrade your body with augmentations, gather an arsenal of high-tech weapons, and carve a path through city ruins, orbital stations, and scorched wastelands. No safe zones. No reinforcements. Just you and a burning contract.

SURVIVE A CIVIL WAR IN SPACE

After a planetary system-wide lockdown, chaos reigns. Your former allies are scattered, your enemies are organized, and every step forward is earned with combat. Outgun corporate enforcers, mutated scavengers, and engineered war beasts in explosive combat.

A STORY-DRIVEN SHOOTER WITH CONSEQUENCES

Make choices that shift allegiances and change how your journey ends. Your relationships matter - save key allies or sacrifice them for tactical advantage. Every mission is a test of loyalty, firepower, and resolve.

CUSTOMIZE A WALKING WEAPON

You're more than a soldier - you're a machine of war. Install neural implants, equip armor plates, and heavy ordnance. Whether you’re storming a spaceport or sneaking through a warzone, your build defines your strategy.

FROM SLUMS TO STARS

From shattered colonies and megacity ghettos to fortified launch bays and orbital death platforms - every location has its own atmosphere.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of destruction of objects and characters using animations of death and blood, as well as rude words in dialogues and story video clips.

short_description: Crimson Frontier is a top-down shooter with RPG elements set in a cyberpunk universe. Battle powerful megacorporations, upgrade your character with augmentations, and uncover the truth in a dystopian world.

English*, Russian*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
